The structure of glycolic acid is shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the table to show what you would **observe** when an aqueous solution of glycolic acid is added separately to each of the reagents. If a reaction occurs, state the functional group of glycolic acid that is responsible for the reaction.

| reagent | observation with glycolic acid | does a reaction occur? ✓ / ✗ | functional group |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3\text{(aq)}$ |  |  |  |
| 2,4-DNPH |  |  |  |
| acidified $\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7^{2-}$ |  |  |  |

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Two reaction sequences to make glycolic acid are shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Suggest the essential condition for reaction $\mathbf{3}$.

parts.label: (b)(v)
parts.text:
Reaction $\mathbf{4}$ occurs via an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.

Complete the diagram for the mechanism for reaction $\mathbf{4}$.

Include all relevant charges, partial charges, curly arrows and lone pairs.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Glycolic acid can also be made by reacting glyoxylic acid with $\text{NaBH}_4$.

{{figure:pdf_visual_04.png}}

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: State the role of $\text{NaBH}_4$ in this reaction.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Write an equation for this reaction using molecular formulae.
Use [H] to represent $\text{NaBH}_4$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
When glycolic acid is heated in the presence of a sulfuric acid catalyst, a new compound, $\mathbf{Y}$, $\text{C}_4\text{H}_4\text{O}_4$, is formed.
The equation for the reaction is given.

$$2\text{CH}_2(\text{OH})\text{CO}_2\text{H} \rightarrow \text{C}_4\text{H}_4\text{O}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$$
glycolic acid $\mathbf{Y}$
